Existing docs inventoried: README.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/*.md (9 files, generated 2026-06-13), _bmad-output/project-context.md, proto-assets/ (7 design/handoff docs), training/{jib,tricks}/README.md + model cards, scripts/jib-atoms.md.

Validation: all internal doc links resolve; every backticked repo path cited in docs/ + CLAUDE.md exists (fixed one dead reference to scripts/seed-seated-figures.sql); no stale React 18 / 'no linter' / '12 categories' claims remain. Also corrected CLAUDE.md (grids moved to lib/compoGrids.js, context hooks in -context.js, 14 categories, 3 new tables + 2 views, new Judging modules section).

open_issues: vercel.json sends Permissions-Policy: microphone=() on every route (verified live on https://wakeref.app/judge/voix) — this disables getUserMedia for the site itself, so /judge/voix and the competition Run tab dictation cannot work in production. Fix would be microphone=(self).

By rule: react/no-unescaped-entities x6, react-hooks/set-state-in-effect x5, react-hooks/immutability x2, no-useless-escape x1; warnings: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps x4, no-unused-vars x3.
